params.name: next-token
params.description: Optional pagination token. Response includes a token to retrieve the next page if available.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of items per page. Default 25. Max 1000.

params.name: days-ago
params.description: Number of days back from current date to retrieve webhook history.

items.docs:
Get the history of webhooks within an optional lookback window, including
specific content URLs and last attempted delivery time and status.
